> Could you please write me a PM explaining what's I did wrong in the tournament settings? Thank you.

The tournament has apparently been deleted since my last message, which is weird.
Anyway, when it still existed, it was:

ITALIAN EUROPEAN QUALIFIER
26 July 2015, 10:00 – 20:00
National Qualifier => the tournament type as entered when created
Italian European Qualifier => the description entered by the creator of the event.

Apparently, it was a CCQ, so the level "National Qualifier" that was entered was wrong. I could have changed it but I wanted to be sure first. Now, the tournament has been deleted so I can't change it.

In order for the qualified players to appear automatically on the www.vekn.net/cc_qualified_2015.html page, the event must be recreated as a CCQ, then the results re-uploaded, then the event reapproved by the National Coordinator Italy.
